subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should maintainers run or accept live Feishu WebSocket proof before any repair or closure, or treat the merged runtime/status fixes as sufficient coverage for this report?
rationale: The distinctive symptom requires Feishu credentials and platform event-delivery proof; source inspection cannot tell whether current main still misses `im.message.receive_v1` while lifecycle events arrive.

options.title: Run live Feishu QA

options.title: Treat related fixes as enough
